rationale: The target and artefacts establish the need to characterise situations requiring braking and whether the vehicle performs the required maneuver, so braking response and activation are legitimately included. However, the scope explicitly incorporates obstacle detection, an enabling observation function. Its functional requirements and its use as the trigger for FR-7.1 do not establish detection itself as part of the phenomenon evaluated by the omitted-braking target.
determining_elements: “Braking-relevant driving situation” is supported by H-1’s collision scenario and FR-7’s obstacle-avoidance requirement.
“Braking response” and braking activation are supported by SG-1, FR-7 and FR-7.1; their inclusion is not overextension merely because they describe system behaviour.

“Including obstacle detection” is the decisive scope extension: FR-7.2 specifies an observation function, while FR-7.1’s detection-relative braking deadline does not by itself bring that function into P.
